title: Board-pattern readiness test — most-repeated question types
chapter: CBSE Class 10 Mathematics · Chapter 12 Surface Areas and Volumes (NCERT reprint 2026-27)
short_title: Class 10 Maths · Ch 12 Surface Areas and Volumes
tagline: Practice questions modelled on past CBSE papers; not predictions of this year's paper.
disclaimer: Original questions modelled on question types that have repeated in CBSE board papers 2023-2026 and the Sample Question Papers 2024-25 to 2026-27. They are practice for readiness, not predictions of what will appear in any exam.
instructions: 40 questions. MCQ and assertion-reason: choose one option. Numeric: type a whole number. Use the value of π given in the question. No calculator.

patterns.T2: Surface area of a combined solid

S1.name: The six solids: formulas
S1.tip: Know the six solids: cone l = √(r² + h²); hemisphere CSA 2πr², TSA 3πr².

S2.name: Surface area of joined solids
S2.tip: Joined faces disappear from the surface area: two cubes of side a → 10a².

S3.name: Toys: cone on a hemisphere
S3.tip: Toy (cone on hemisphere): TSA = 2πr² + πrl; cone height = total − r.

S4.name: Tents and capsules
S4.tip: Tent canvas = cylinder CSA + cone CSA (no floor). Capsule = cylinder + one sphere.

S6.name: Volume with a cavity (subtract)
S6.tip: Cavities and raised bottoms: subtract volumes.

S7.name: Surface area with hollows
S7.tip: A scooped hollow adds its curved surface and removes a flat face.

S8.name: Counting pieces, mass, ratios
S8.tip: Pieces = available volume ÷ one piece; mass = volume × density; cancel π in ratios.

S9.name: Case studies
S9.tip: Case studies: identify the two solids first, then decide add or subtract.

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cone of radius r and slant height l is:
The total surface area of a solid hemisphere of radius r is:
questions.explanation: Curved 2πr² + flat base πr² (a 2024 board type).

questions.question: Find the slant height (in cm) of a cone of radius 6 cm and height 8 cm.
The base area of a cone is 30 cm² and its volume is 60 cm³. Find its height in cm.
questions.explanation: 60 = ⅓ × 30 × h (SQP 2025-26 Q11 type, new numbers).

questions.question: Choose the correct option.
questions.explanation: A is true; a sphere's surface area is 4πr², so R is false (a 2025 board type).
questions.assertion: Two solid hemispheres of the same radius joined along their bases form a sphere.
questions.reason: The total surface area of a sphere of radius r is 3πr².
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

questions.question: Two identical cubes of side a are joined end to end. The total surface area of the cuboid formed is:
questions.explanation: 12a² − 2a² for the two joined faces (a 2024 board type).

questions.question: Two cubes, each of volume 125 cm³, are joined end to end. Find the surface area of the cuboid formed, in cm².
Three cubes of side 4 cm are joined end to end in a row. Find the surface area of the cuboid formed, in cm².
A hemisphere of diameter 14 cm stands on the top face of a cube of edge 14 cm. Find the total surface area of the solid in cm². Use π = 22/7.
A hemisphere of radius r is fixed on one face of a cube of edge 2r. The surface area of the solid is:
A toy is a cone of slant height l on a hemisphere of the same radius r. Its total surface area is:
questions.explanation: Curved hemisphere + curved cone; the joined base is hidden.

questions.question: A toy is a cone on a hemisphere, both of radius 7 cm. The total height of the toy is 31 cm. Find its total surface area in cm². Use π = 22/7.
questions.explanation: Cone h = 24, l = 25: 308 + 550 = 858 (NCERT Exercise 12.1 Q3 type).

questions.question: A solid is a cone of height 4 cm on a hemisphere, both of radius 3 cm. Its volume is kπ cm³. Find k.
A toy is a cone on a hemisphere, both of radius 7 cm. Its total volume is 1232 cm³. Find the height of the cone in cm. Use π = 22/7.
questions.explanation: Hemisphere 718⅔ → cone 513⅓ = ⅓ × 22/7 × 49 × h → h = 10 (SQP 2026-27 Q34(B) type).

TSA of cylinder + TSA of cone

questions.question: A tent is a cylinder of radius 7 m and height 4 m with a conical top of slant height 10 m. Find the canvas needed (no floor) in m². Use π = 22/7.

A capsule is a cylinder with a hemisphere at each end. Its total length is 21 mm and its diameter 7 mm. Find its surface area in mm². Use π = 22/7.
questions.explanation: Cylinder 14 long: 308 + sphere 154 = 462 (NCERT Exercise 12.1 Q6 type).

questions.question: A tent is a cylinder of diameter 28 m and height 5 m with a conical top; the total height is 15.5 m. Find the canvas needed (no floor) in m². Use π = 22/7.
The volume of a solid made by joining two solids is:
options: the sum minus the joined face area

questions.question: A shed is a cuboid 20 m × 14 m × 6 m with a half cylinder of diameter 14 m along its 20 m length on top. Find the volume in m³. Use π = 22/7.
A model is a cylinder with a cone at each end. Its total length is 20 cm, its diameter 14 cm and each cone is 3 cm high. Find its volume in cm³. Use π = 22/7.
A capsule is a cylinder with a hemisphere at each end, total length 12 cm and diameter 6 cm. Its volume is kπ cm³. Find k.
A solid is a cone standing on a hemisphere, both of radius 1 cm, and the height of the cone equals its radius. Its volume is:
A glass is a cylinder of inner diameter 6 cm and height 12 cm with a raised hemispherical bottom of the same radius. Its actual capacity is kπ cm³. Find k.
A pen stand is a cuboid 30 cm × 20 cm × 5 cm with four conical depressions, each of radius 3.5 cm and depth 3 cm. Find the volume of wood in cm³. Use π = 22/7.
From a solid cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 12 cm, a cone of the same radius and height is removed. Find the remaining volume in cm³. Use π = 22/7.
A hemisphere is scooped out of each end of a solid cylinder of radius r and height h. The total surface area of the article is:
questions.explanation: Curved cylinder + two curved hollows (NCERT Exercise 12.1 Q9).

questions.question: A hemisphere is scooped out of each end of a solid cylinder of height 12 cm and radius 7 cm. Find the total surface area of the article in cm². Use π = 22/7.
From a solid cylinder of height 8 cm and radius 6 cm, a cone of the same height and radius is hollowed out. Its total surface area is kπ cm². Find k.
A hemispherical depression of diameter 14 cm is cut out of one face of a cube of edge 28 cm. Find the surface area of the remaining solid in cm². Use π = 22/7.
A cone of radius 6 cm and height 9 cm is full of water. Lead spheres of radius 1.5 cm are dropped in until one-third of the water flows out. How many spheres were dropped?
questions.explanation: Cone 108π; ⅓ = 36π; each sphere 4.5π (NCERT Exercise 12.2 Q5 type).
